Apple (AAPL) vs Broadcom (AVGO): on the same formula, their operating margins are 6.9 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AAPL: $478.8B · AVGO: $63.9B
• Revenue growth — AAPL: +15.1% · AVGO: +23.9%
• Operating margin — AAPL: 33.0% · AVGO: 39.9%
• Net margin — AAPL: 27.6% · AVGO: 36.2%
• Free cash flow margin — AAPL: 28.4% · AVGO: 42.1%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AAPL: 5.0% · AVGO: 23.5%

Different fiscal years: AAPL Sep 26, 2026 · AVGO Nov 2, 2025. The periods are not identical.
